public.task: Update the routine while preserving the established behavior.
public.title: Routine update

final_conclusion.change_summary: The updated run() filters payload items with `if value`, excluding falsy items such as 0, None, or False. It also adds a guard to return mean=None when no values remain. The visible test only covers positive values and passes, but the filtering changes established behavior for inputs containing zero or other falsy values.
final_conclusion.final_conclusion: The change may break the established behavior for inputs containing zero or other falsy values, even though the visible positive-value test passes.

evidence: Visible test only checks positive values [10, 20] and does not cover zero/falsy items.
findings.summary: Filtering falsy items alters count and mean for inputs that include zero values, which were previously counted as valid items.

tests_run: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v (conceptual: visible test test_positive_values passes; execution not available)
